→ **Volume.** Go through far more deals, because the more you see, the faster you find the one you’ll eventually close on

→ **Confidence.** Walk into every advisor call, broker call, and seller call already knowing the big issues you want to discuss versus spinning your wheels finding them 

### ✨** What it actually catches**

We ran a real deal through it. Up top, it laid out the asking price, revenue, SDE, and the implied multiple. 

**Then it went to work, catching…**

**#1**: An SDE number **that didn't hold up once you saw how much the two owners added back **

**#2**: Heavy equipment that meant** capex would quietly eat the cash flow **

**#3:** **A lease good only through 2028**, then year-to-year, with the yard on month-to-month 

**#4:** A DSCR that passed on average but failed in 2023, **which is how lenders actually check it**

==**And it didn't just flag problems. The deal review proposed a path**==: to push valuation toward $4.5M, you'd likely need a seller note on a two-year standby, ideally forgivable and tied to performance.

That's the kind of read that used to take a call and a day of waiting.

### 🙌** One thing I want to be straight about**

**This does not replace our advisor team in any way. **

Every [Pro](https://pro.smbdealhunter.xyz/) member still gets human eyes on any deal they want a second opinion on,** in Slack or one on one. **

==**Last month alone we spent over 238+ hours on Zoom calls with members on live deals. **==

That doesn't change. What changes is your first read happens in minutes instead of 24 to 48 hours.

messages.subject: Webinar: Understanding a Quality of Earnings Analysis: What's Included and Why
messages.text_excerpt:
( https://3be9da90.click.kit-mail3.com/wvuv9qmrvlfghk2ppo6i7hnd5mnpdi8hnwn8w/58hvh7hg8w0xnpi6h4/aHR0cHM6Ly91czAyd2ViLnpvb20udXMvd2ViaW5hci9yZWdpc3Rlci83MTE3ODEyMTE0NTU5L1dOX1cyOUtJTUJOUUdpdlhsRGh1THJ5ekE= )

Max Lummis and Travis Sadler of diligence firm LCS breaks down the key components of a Quality of Earnings (QoE) analysis and explains why it plays such a critical role in business transactions.

Whether you're preparing to buy, sell, or evaluate a company, understanding a QoE can help you make more informed decisions.

​​Register here.​ ( https://3be9da90.click.kit-mail3.com/wvuv9qmrvlfghk2ppo6i7hnd5mnpdi8hnwn8w/58hvh7hg8w0xnpi6h4/aHR0cHM6Ly91czAyd2ViLnpvb20udXMvd2ViaW5hci9yZWdpc3Rlci83MTE3ODEyMTE0NTU5L1dOX1cyOUtJTUJOUUdpdlhsRGh1THJ5ekE= )​

In this webinar, you'll learn:

* How a QoE analysis reveals a company's true financial story

* What makes revenue real, repeatable, and sustainable

* How adjusted EBITDA helps identify a business's actual earning power

* Common balance sheet risks that can create costly surprises for buyers

* The role of working capital, debt-like items, and closing adjustments in a transaction

Bring your questions for Q&A at the end.

👉 This coming Thursday, June 18th.

-->Register Here ( https://3be9da90.click.kit-mail3.com/wvuv9qmrvlfghk2ppo6i7hnd5mnpdi8hnwn8w/58hvh7hg8w0xnpi6h4/aHR0cHM6Ly91czAyd2ViLnpvb20udXMvd2ViaW5hci9yZWdpc3Rlci83MTE3ODEyMTE0NTU5L1dOX1cyOUtJTUJOUUdpdlhsRGh1THJ5ekE= )

Register Here ( https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/7117812114559/WN_W29KIMBNQGivXlDhuLryzA )See you Thursday!

(P.S. Even if you can't make it live on Thursday, register to receive a recording of the event.)
